Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} (revenant family; the only one tied to a Camarilla clan rather than the Sabbat)

Patron Clan: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere}

During the ancient struggle between the Carpathian @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} and the nascent Tremere, the Krevcheski revenant family saw a chance to escape its bondage to the Tzimisce and threw its fortunes in with the fledgling Tremere instead. The Tzimisce-loyal members of the family suffered horribly for the betrayal, but the rest survived under Tremere protection and, generations later, became known as the Ducheski — already twisted into revenants by Tzimisce blood-sorcery, with a handful of Tremere who understood the peculiarities of that blood helping guide the family's breeding ever since.

Role: The Ducheski are the Tremere's only revenant asset, serving as retainers and stewards on two large family estates (one in Europe, one in the United States), each managed by a nominal family head chosen by seniority. Tremere regents look after the family's finances and internal matters, and identify suitable candidates from within the family for "special projects" on the clan's behalf.

Disciplines: As a revenant bloodline descended from the Tzimisce-linked Krevcheski, Ducheski retain a thin thread of Vicissitude potential, though most never manifest it without Tremere blood magic assistance.

Weakness: Ducheski almost never receive the Embrace — the circumstances of their creation and upbringing instill deep loyalty to the Tremere, but leave most with little personal initiative or social skill, making them poor candidates for unlife on their own.

Careful, deliberate breeding ensures the family produces at least a few true revenants each generation, while constant Tremere oversight has bred a nearly hivelike loyalty into the bloodline — a resource the clan guards as one of its most closely held secrets.
